training_data: ISLES'24 training set, patients with 90-day mRS (n = 129, 44 with mRS 3-6); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
intended_use: research only: external validation of the feasibility estimates on an independent cohort; not for clinical decision-making

input_requirements.clinical: 22 pre-procedural variables in physical units, column names as in features_clinical_22.txt (missing values allowed; median imputation fitted on the training cohort is inside each pipeline)
input_requirements.ctp: 53 CTP features computed with s02_ctp_features.features_from_maps on CBF/CBV/MTT/Tmax maps in physical units, clipped to CBF 100, CBV 10, MTT 30, Tmax 30 (same grid handling as the paper)

warnings: The clinical GBM is overconfident (cross-validated calibration slope 0.58); recalibrate before any use.
Absolute CTP thresholds are not unit-transportable: on ISLES 2018 the maps had to be rescaled first.
Trained on 129 patients from two inferred centres; transportability is untested.
